    The projective category of split basic data in the multiplicative-bases language #

    SplitBasicData.primitiveIdempotents is the basic set of primitive idempotents of S; SplitBasicData.pidx labels the objects of the projective category S.toIdempotents.ProjectiveCategory (a morphism X ⟶ Y is an element of e_Y B e_X). Morphism values lie in corners, automorphisms are corner units, two-sided unit orbits are rays, and the radical of an endomorphism ring is the corner radical.
